# Single Page Test Document

This is a test document intentionally formatted to verify single-page compilation.

## Section 1: Overview

Docconv provides deterministic conversion of Markdown documents to Word (.docx), PDF, and per-page PNG raster images.
It executes within an isolated container environment with metric-compatible fonts.

## Section 2: Validation

The verify command checks page geometry and page budget constraints against exact, minimum, or maximum limits.
